name: io.github.fitzyracing1/superuser
description: Permission-gated superuser (sysadmin) MCP agent with enterprise guardrails and audit.

environmentVariables.name: SUPERUSER_HUMAN_OWNER
environmentVariables.description: Human accountable for the agent's actions (recorded in every audit entry).

environmentVariables.name: SUPERUSER_APPROVAL_AT
environmentVariables.description: Minimum risk level that triggers the human-approval gate: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, or CRITICAL.

environmentVariables.name: AI_DEFENSE_INSPECTION_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Cisco AI Defense Inspection API key for runtime tool-call/response inspection.

environmentVariables.name: DUO_TOKEN_URL
environmentVariables.description: Cisco Duo OAuth 2.1 token endpoint (client-credentials) for per-tool-call authorization.

environmentVariables.name: DUO_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Cisco Duo OAuth client ID for the agent's non-human identity.

environmentVariables.name: STRIPE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Stripe secret API key for usage-based (metered) billing.
